ui.forge.natal_help: From Heart Tempering one weapon can be your Natal treasure. It grows with you: kills, techniques and ore fed at the forge raise it to level 10 (+2% stats a level), and its item level follows yours up to the grade band above its own. A boss's shatter blow, or drawing on it with too little Spirit, breaks it until it is re-forged.
ui.forge.reroll_help: Choose a piece with affixes. Lock one affix to keep it (the reroll then costs double), roll the rest again, and choose the old roll or the new.
ui.forge.salvage_help: Tap pieces to break them down into their metal and Refining Essence. Worn, bound and locked pieces are never salvaged.
